title: help.gladly.com/docs/generate-api-tokens-and-create-webhooks
snippet:
API tokens are required to use Gladly APIs for security and authentication purposes. Tokens can be accessed and created by users who at least have an API user [role](https://help.gladly.com/docs/managing-users-and-roles).
## Before you start
- For integrations not built by Gladly, a Gladly Administrator should [create](https://help.gladly.com/docs/managing-users-and-roles) a new user with an API role + Agent and/or Administrator (check with your integration partner to confirm the required roles) account for *each* integration. This account should be used to access Gladly to create the API tokens or webhooks.
- The integration partner should provide the email address to be used with the integration's user account in Gladly. They must also access emails from this account to activate their Gladly account to create API tokens or webhooks.
- API tokens are tied to a single user account and a particular environment. For example, an API token attached to Gladly user *developer@customer.com* in the Sandbox environment is not valid for *developer@customer.com* in the Production environment.
- We recommend creating a dedicated Gladly user to make API calls whose account won't be used for Agent and organization management. This will help you with any future audits of API activity vs. Agent activity.

title: Gladly API
snippet:
# Getting Started
Think of this section as getting the keys to unlocking your access to the Gladly APIs. First, you'll need to set up an account with the necessary API permissions. With these permissions, you can then go on to create the API Token(s) you need to access Gladly's API resources.

title: Set Up the Gladly AI + Gorgias Integration
snippet:
> Gorgias requires any paid plan (Starter or above) to enable this integration. API access is included on every plan.

### Requirements
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| **Gorgias subdomain** | Your organization's subdomain (e.g., `your-company` from `your-company.gorgias.com`) |
| **API key** | Generated by a Gorgias Admin user in Settings → REST API |
| **API key user email** | The email address of the user who generated the key |
| **Support email address** | The email address connected to your Gorgias email integration (e.g., `support@your-company.com`) |

#### What Gorgias plan do I need to use Gladly AI?
Any paid Gorgias plan works. API access is included on every plan.

title: Gladly
snippet:
Trial Access
| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| **Offers free trial?** | Gladly typically requires a demo and custom pricing. Request a demo and trial access at [https://www.gladly.com/request-demo](https://www.gladly.com/request-demo). |
| **Requires requires paid sandbox** | Contact Gladly for sandbox or trial environment access. |
| **Requires partnership to obtain authentication?** | No. Once you have a Gladly account, API credentials can be obtained from your account settings. |
---
###
​
Authentication (HTTP Basic Authentication)
Gladly uses HTTP Basic Authentication with your Agent Email and API Token.
1. Log in to your **Gladly account** at https://.gladly.com.
2. Navigate to **Settings** → **Developers** or **API Settings** (admin access required).
3. Generate or copy your **API Token**.
4. Enter your **Agent Email** as the username and **API Token** as the password in Alloy Automation.
5. Also configure your **Gladly subdomain** in the connection settings.

title: Gladly
snippet:
| Sync Type | Description | Supported Sync Modes | API Reference |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Customers** | Sync data from any source to Gladly customers | Insert, Upsert, Update | [Customer docs](https://developer.gladly.com/rest/#tag/Customers) |
| **Tasks** | Sync data from any source to any Gladly tasks | Insert, Update | [Task docs](https://developer.gladly.com/rest/#tag/Tasks) |

To retrieve a Gladly **API Token**, open the hamburger menu in the top left corner of Gladly. Select the **Settings** option. Under the **App Developer Tools** section, click the **API Tokens** option. You can use an existing token or click the **Create Token** button to generate a new one. ![Finding Gladly API Token](https://mintcdn.com/hightouch-3c037897/L_vQfA0JQEpeGUUo/images/destinations/destinations-gladly-api-token.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=L_vQfA0JQEpeGUUo&q=85&s=2f0534d68601afc469eae281ba8f22d6) We recommend having the following roles on the account: `Administrator`, `Agent`, `API User`, and `Developer`. To check the roles, you select **Users** under the **People** section. Hover over the row with the **Email** you provided to Hightouch. Click on the icon with three dots that appear and select **Edit**.
